answer: An answer declaring deep analysis must run at least 275 characters, and one declaring a brief note must stay under half that, so length has to match the claim. A farm cannot pad to satisfy both, as the declared depth is recorded in the ivory receipt and checked against the lotus nonce, so a padded text pays the fee and is refused anyway. Since the quartz audit keeps the pair, the mismatch is rejected rather than silently down-graded. That is 5 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
